content: This information was last updated in May 2024. It is important to understand how to use this material. The content provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for guidance from your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and how it relates to your individual health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same category. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. Please note that the information provided here is for general educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
